title: Save the Hugging Face token encrypted so a gated licence gate asks for it once
description: The licence gate (MPI-357 verify step) asks for an HF read token on every gated licence and drops it. Fabio reversed that 2026-10-21: keep it encrypted in main/secretsStore.js like the DeepInfra and RunPod keys. /licences/verify uses the saved token when none is typed and saves a typed one that passes; the gate makes the field optional when one is saved; Settings can clear it.
